description: Use this when someone has a PDF of a data sheet, for example one a supplier sent, and asks whether it is genuine, still valid or the latest version: "Is this SDS still current?", "Is my copy outdated?". Tells whether a PDF is a document a checked manufacturer published on ProofPass, and whether it is still the current version. Give its SHA-256 checksum (64 hex digits) or its ProofPass PDF URL (/pdf/…). For a superseded version it returns the current one. / Prüft, ob eine PDF veröffentlicht und noch die aktuelle Fassung ist. Do not use to check the content or completeness of a sheet (use check_sds_structure). It recognises only PDFs published on ProofPass.

document.description: SHA-256 of the file (64 hex digits) or its PDF URL on ProofPass

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: verify_document
title: Verify a data sheet PDF
